import random

def {{fn_name}}(arr, k):
    arr = list(arr)
    lo, hi = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while lo < hi:
        pivot = arr[random.randint(lo, hi)]
        i, j = lo, hi
        while i <= j:
            while arr[i] < pivot: i += 1
            while arr[j] > pivot: j -= 1
            if i <= j:
                arr[i], arr[j] = arr[j], arr[i]
                i += 1; j -= 1
        if k <= j: hi = j
        elif k >= i: lo = i
        else: return arr[k]
    return arr[k]
